execution.changedPathAuthority: Exactly the eight backendWritable paths below; no sibling, generated, migration or formatting-spill authority exists.
requiredOutcomes: Performance Cycle binds and verifies the trusted tenant once after canonical authority and before any V1 table read or write in every transactional entry point.

The event handoff enumerates ACTIVE tenants outside protected tables, revalidates and locks ACTIVE in each claim transaction, binds the tenant and claims only that tenant without exceeding one global batch budget.
Delivery, failure, quarantine and replay updates bind and predicate the exact trusted tenant, event and delivery attempt without widening existing fencing or idempotency behavior.

Actual PostgreSQL ENABLE plus FORCE RLS policies use identical USING and WITH CHECK expressions for the four tables, with distinct NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS runtime and migration/routine-owner roles and catalog assertions.
The V2/V3 SECURITY DEFINER trigger stack, snapshot provider/refetch path, crash rollback, ordering, retry, quarantine, replay and exactly-once behavior pass the bounded evidence group.
Run the bounded test command once; after a failure rerun only the smallest affected selector.
execution.branchPolicy: Commit and push only this backend branch, independently review its exact commit and PostgreSQL evidence with zero unresolved P0, P1 or P2, then use a separate central admission decision before any no-ff merge to backend dwp-dev.

product authorization v59, Auth V268, Gateway or frontend authorization source
tenant enrollment, activation, assignment, broad permission or production release
source changes outside the exact eight-path allowlist
repository-wide test repetition without a focused failure proving it necessary
